tournament.description:
We're excited to confirm that a total of 18 teams have registered for the 2v2 World Cup 2026! This is a great result, and we look forward to providing the best cup experience possible to you.

# Format
A summary is provided in this article. Full details of the format breakdown can be found in > [THIS DOCUMENT](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1V0xnGVfZsgRzFUhf92ysGfRzpFK22Dj6cqZQE2nPyTQ/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.ltd8tag1p7io) <. We would recommend browsing this document after reading the summary here, as it also provides visual aids and examples.

Please note that although everything mentioned here is intended to be final, there may be times that we need to make tweaks. These will always be communicated.
## Overview
The tournament will be one single division, and has 3 stages:
* Group Stage
* Playoff Stage
* Finals Stage

The format is designed to:
* Give teams the opportunity to play against similarly performing opponents whenever possible.
* Reward teams for performing well.
* Scope the tournament length to a reasonable size.

## Matches will all be TIME ATTACK
Each map is played over a number of rounds.

A round is complete after a team gets 2 caps. Each player on the team must cap. This fully resets the map for the next round.

Synchronised deaths shall be enforced, meaning we will use the same mod that is used on Certified Servers today.

* Group Matches = BO4 maps, BO3 rounds per map
  * Time Limit = 8 minutes, no overtime, ties possible
* Playoff Matches = BO5 maps, BO3 rounds per map
  * Time Limit = 8 minutes with overtime, no ties
* Finals Matches = BO5 maps, BO5 rounds per map
  * Time Limit = 8 minutes with overtime, no ties

As soon as the overall result for a map or a match is guaranteed, the map or match shall end immediately.

## Map Banning and Picking

Across all matches, the same pattern shall be used to facilitate the banning and picking of maps:
* a/b = ban
* A/B = pick
* a b B A b a B A
* The WEAKER team can always choose to be A or B
  * In Group Stage, WEAKER team = lower seed rating
  * In Playoff Stage, WEAKER team = lower group ranking
  * In Finals Stage, WEAKER team = lower playoff score

## Group Stage

The 18 teams will be seeded #1 to #18 by the admin team.

Seeds will be categorised into Tiers:
* S Tier - #1 #2 #3
* A Tier - #4 #5 #6
* B Tier - #7 #8 #9
* C Tier - #10 #11 #12
* D Tier - #13 #14 #15
* E Tier - #16 #17 #18

Teams will be divided into 3 groups of 6. Each group will contain a seed from each tier, randomly selected.

You will play each team in your group once, making a total of 5 matches per team.

After all group games are played, progression to the next stages will be determined as follows:
* 1st position skips playoff stage, goes directly into Quarter Finals of the last stage.
* Best 2nd position of the 3 groups, skips playoff stage, goes directly into Quarter Finals of the last stage.
* Other 2nd positions, skips playoff stage, goes directly into the last stage (pre Quarter Finals).
* 3rd, 4th, 5th & 6th positions proceed to the playoff stage.

## Playoff Stage

The Playoff Stage uses a modified Swiss style qualification format. 

Teams are assigned an initial bracket based on their Group Stage placement:
* 3rd place teams: start in the 1-0 bracket.
* 4th and 5th place teams: start in the 0-0 bracket.
* 6th place teams: start in the 0-1 bracket.

A team:
* Qualifies for Finals Stage after its second win.
* Is eliminated after its second loss.

Your match-ups within a given bracket will be calculated dynamically, to avoid repeat match-ups wherever possible.

## Finals Stage

This is a single elimination bracket.

The Pre-Quarter Finals will be populated by the 6 teams that  progressed via the playoffs + the 2 "worst" 2nd place teams from the group stage.

The Quarter Finals will be populated by the 3 1st place teams from the group stage, the "best" 2nd place team from the group stage, and the 4 winners from the Pre-Quarter Finals.

# Maps

Given the format and a single division, we have decided to select the following 13 maps:

* [CTF-BT-II-PaceyCB](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-PaceyCB)
* [CTF-BT-II-FaithCB](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-FaithCB)
* [CTF-BT-II-DoubleVision-CE](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-DoubleVision-CE)
* [CTF-BT-II-(K)LegendsV2](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-(K)LegendsV2)
* [CTF-BT-II-Fleurdelys](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-Fleurdelys)
* [CTF-BT-II-Extant](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-Extant)
* [CTF-BT-II-SkaarjInvasionV2](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-SkaarjInvasionV2)
* [CTF-BT-II-CoZyliciouS](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-CoZyliciouS)
* [CTF-BT-II-AztecCE](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-AztecCE)
* HARDER - [CTF-BT-II-SynchronizeV4](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-SynchronizeV4)
* HARDER - [CTF-BT-II-FuriumMineCE](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-FuriumMineCE)
* HARDER - [CTF-BT-II-Invention](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-Invention)
* HARDER - [CTF-BT-II-Diplopia](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-Diplopia)

Teams that are seeded in S tier, A tier or B tier are eligible to play ALL maps

Teams that are seeded in C tier, D tier or E tier can choose to VETO the HARDER maps.

This essentially means that:
* Weaker teams need to only learn the 9 easier maps.
* Stronger teams need to learn the full 13 maps.

Weaker teams can choose to play the harder maps against other teams, if they wish - and they can always VETO them.

PLEASE NOTE - due to negative feedback received, this map-list no longer includes [CTF-BT-II-GalaxyOfTheDcW](https://utbt.net/maps/CTF-BT-II-GalaxyOfTheDcW)

tournament.rules:
* Each player can only be a part of 1 team
* We will support cross region matches, but we inform you that your teammate **must** play on the same server as you (opponents are global).
* We expect all participants to commit to showing up to matches. No shows will results in warnings and bans from our platform.
* Team names may not contain anything offensive/vulgar, we love the banter, but keep it reasonable.
